content: The System Template shall provide the ability to define nam- ing conventions for public symbols Type: valid 5 33 of 42  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 213: AUTOSAR_RS_SystemTemplate Requirements on System Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Description: The System Template shall provide the ability to define naming conventions for public symbols. This especially includes requirement ids, module abbreviations, meta data and configuration symbols used in the document of a release Rationale: Avoid ambiguities and name clashes inside the specification. Provide a consistent uniform presentation of meta data to the reader of the specification. Allow automatic processing of specification elements Use Case: Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
